children: Lisata Therapeutics shares rose after the company said it acquired Marea Therapeutics.
The stock climbed 17% to $1.72. Shares are still down 12% this year.
Concurrent with the acquisition, Lisata agreed to sell Series C non-voting convertible stock in a private placement, which is expected to generate $225 million in gross proceeds.

Lisata plans to use the proceeds to advance MAR001/005 and MAR002, two antibody therapies developed by Marea. The drugs are in ongoing studies expected to report topline data in the fourth quarter of 2027.
